name: TOGAF-Compliant System Architecture Document (SAD) Swarm
description: Multi-agent swarm for planning, extracting baseline current state, designing target state, conducting gap/impact analyses, generating viewpoint diagrams, and refining the final SAD.

outputs.spec: TOGAF-compliant System Architecture Document (SAD) for ${topic}. Target length: ${word_count_target} words. Core Sections: Scope and Context, Baseline Application Architecture, Target Application Architecture, Gap Analysis, Impact Analysis, and Architecture Viewpoints (Catalogs, Matrices, Diagrams in Mermaid).

tasks.description: Planner Agent: Decompose focus topic '${topic}' into a structured TOGAF-compliant System Architecture Document outline targeting a length of ${word_count_target} words. Scope context, identify stakeholders, baseline, target states, and draft the Scope and Context section of the report.

Current State Analyst: Query the knowledge graph (`query_graph`) and scan workspace repository files (`read_file`) to document the Baseline Application Architecture (Current State) of the system '${topic}'. Compile the Application Portfolio Catalog (identifying core components like web servers, APIs, runtime engines) and the Interface Catalog (API endpoints, protocols, data models).

Target State Architect: Define the Target Application Architecture (Future State) for the system '${topic}'. Explicitly distinguish between Logical Application Components (abstraction of functionality independent of implementation) and Physical Application Components (actual deployed software/services). Define key meta-model relationships: realizes (Component to Service), supports (Service to Process), consumes (Actor/Role to Service), accesses/updates (Component to Data Entity), communicates with (Component to Component), and hosts (Technology to Component).

Delta Analyst: Analyze the delta between baseline and target states. Explicitly identify components to be created, updated, or decommissioned (Gap Analysis). Perform Impact Analysis detailing security, downstream reporting, and infrastructure impacts.

Viewpoint Designer: Formulate architectural viewpoints. Generate Catalogs and Matrices (Application/Business Function Matrix, Application/Data Matrix). Write out Diagrams (Application Communication Diagram, Application and User Location Diagram, Enterprise Manageability Diagram) using Mermaid syntax.

Publishing Editor: Refine the combined draft section-by-section using sliding window constraints to ensure consistency, tone, and that the final output satisfies the target length of ${word_count_target} words. Write the final TOGAF-compliant System Architecture Document (SAD) to '${output_file}'.

metadata.notes: Single-laptop optimized TOGAF SAD report swarm. The codebase is analyzed via graph queries first.
